name: ICAConfPubs
description: This paper presents a comprehensive dataset of past ICA (The International Communication Association) annual conference papers from 2003 to 2018, encompassing 27,466 papers, 21,038 authors, and 4,935 sessions. We made the dataset publicly available in both CSV and JSON formats. Additionally, we developed an API to facilitate programmatic access, and an intuitive user interface to enable users to navigate and explore the data more easily. The web application, API documentation, downloadable data, and reproducible code to obtain and process the data are available at https://ica.hongtaoh.com.
